content.value: Document Type - Clinical Document provides details of a patient's condition or care documents. This feature allows the user to retrieve, add or modify information of a specific patient or a specific clinical document of a patient. It also provides a facility to retrieve clinical document in HTML. The document content could be images, XML.etc.

Miscellaneous documents providing details of a patient’s condition or care. These should only be used when no other classification is appropriate, and the care in question was not provided by a provider or entity within the practice (e.g., in-house lab). By default, clinical documents are created in an open status.

Patient Admission or Discharge documentation typically provided as informational-only to the ambulatory athenahealth provider, e.g., inpatient, behavioral/mental health admissions, discharges from an neonatal facility.

Consult and supporting documentation incoming from other providers. Consult notes are medical documents from an outside provider that report on a patient’s visit or procedure performed by that provider, e.g., physician correspondence, medical record photocopies, checklists of patient plans. Standalone Lab, Imaging and Diagnostic Results/Reports have their own classes.
Emergency Department notes and notifications, e.g., ER daily lists. Notes from walk-in clinics, urgent care, and retail clinic facilities, e.g., Minute Clinic, Express Care.

Mental health notes, e.g., behavioral assessments, completed by psychologists, social workers, licensed mental health counselors. Neurologist notes should be classified as a Consult Note. This class should only include questionnaires if they are attached to more detailed mental health notes.

Letters or forms from outside physicians, medical groups, or internal providers describing surgical procedures. The words “Operative Note” or “Operative Report” typically appear at the top of these forms. Describes surgical procedures performed in hospital or surgical center settings, typically requiring both an incision and anesthesia/analgesia, as well as booking in a surgical center or dental/ophtho office. Endoscopic procedures with biopsy should be classified under Imaging/Diagnostic Result.
Note: Subclassification is not necessary for this document class. Also, when adding documents, the attachmentcontents should be no larger than 20MB for optimal API processing time. Please
for more best practices on File Uploads.

primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Creates an action note for a specific clinical document

actionnote.description: The new action note to add to the document.

errormessage.description: If there was an error with this call and SUCCESS is set to false, this field may provide additional information.

newdocumentid.description: The document ID of newly created document as a result of action of Deny-New Prescription To Follow (DNTF).

success.description: Returns true if the update was a success.

versiontoken.description: A token representing the current state of this document. Will only be set if VERSIONTOKEN was originally sent to the endpoint.

primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Retrieves action note information of a specific clinical document

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: Number of entries to return (default 1500, max 5000)

status.description: Status given for this document action.

priority.description: Priority given for this document action.

createdby.description: The username of the person that created this document action.

patientid.description: The patient ID this document is tied to.

actionnote.description: The action notes that are attached to the document.

assignedto.description: This field will describe who was assigned this document during this document action.

createddatetime.description: The datetime this action note was created.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Add clinical document to patient's chart
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Creates a clinical document record of a specific patient

entityid.description: Identifier of entity creating the document. entitytype is required while passing entityid.

priority.description: Priority of this result.  1 is high; 2 is normal.

autoclose.description: Documents will, normally, automatically appear in the clinical inbox for providers to review. In some cases, you might want to force the document to skip the clinical inbox, and go directly to the patient chart with a "closed" status. For that case, set this to true.

entitytype.description: Type of entity creating the document. entityid is required while passing entitytype.

providerid.description: The ID of the ordering provider.

departmentid.description: The athenaNet department ID associated with the uploaded document.

internalnote.description: An internal note for the provider or staff. Updating this will append to any previous notes and has a limit of 4000 characters.

observationdate.description: The date an observation was made (mm/dd/yyyy).

observationtime.description: The time an observation was made (hh24:mi).  24 hour time.

originalfilename.description: The original file name of this document without the file extension. Filename should not exceed 200 characters.

attachmentcontents.description:
The file contents that will be attached to this document. File must be Base64 encoded. 
		Please note encrypted PDFs are not supported with document upload APIs.

clinicalproviderid.description: The ID of the external provider/lab/pharmacy associated the document.

success.description: Returns true/false if the operation was successful.

errormessage.description: If the operation failed, this will contain an error message.

clinicaldocumentid.description: The document ID of the new or modified document.

primaryEndpoints.exampleCode:
curl -X POST 'https://api.preview.platform.athenahealth.com/v1/{practiceid}/patients/{patientid}/documents/clinicaldocument' \
  -F attachmentcontents=@{filename} \
  -F attachmenttype={filetype} \
  -F departmentid={departmentId} \
  -F documentsubclass={documentSubClass} \
  -H "accept: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {bearerToken}"

inputParameters.description: By default, deleted documents are not listed.  Set to list these.

fileextension.description: The file extension of this document.

observationdate.description: Date of the encounter associated with this document

lastmodifieduser.description: The user who last modified this document.

originalfilename.description: The original file name of this document.

providerusername.description: The username of the provider associated with this document.

clinicaldocumentid.description: The primary key for the clinical document.

clinicalproviderid.description: The ID of the clinical provider associated with this clinical document. Clinical providers are a master list of providers throughout the country.  These include providers as well as radiology centers, labs and pharmacies.

lastmodifieddatetime.description: Date/time (ISO 8601) the document was last modified
